description: Move a component to just before or after another component on the current page — reorder sections, swap columns, lift a CTA above the footer. The component keeps its id, classes and id-styles. ALWAYS use this to reorder; delete + re-add loses the component's styles.

anchorPath.description: Path (from the same `read_page`) of the component to place it next to.

position.description: Which side of the anchor. Default after.

targetPath.description: Path (from the most recent `read_page`) of the component to move.

name: swebsy_move_section
title: Move section
